PLANNING COMMISSION
PLANNING COMMISSION
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday DECEMBER 12, 2019
7:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
1. Call to Order
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair Avery
Commissioner French, Henderson, and Smith
5. Review of Agenda
6. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
7. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
8. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of November 14, 2019
Minutes
9. Public Hearings
9A. Site Plan Review 19-004 and Density Bonus Agreement 19-001
Meta Housing Corporation, Applicant
A request to develop an affordable housing project on a 4.75-acre vacant site located at the southeast corner of Avenue R and Division Street.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-050 approving Site Plan Review 19-004, recommend that the City Council approve Density Bonus Agreement 19-001, and adopt the Mitigated Negative Declaration and Mitigation Monitoring and Reporting Program finding that the project will not result in a significant impact on the environment. Perry Banner, Contract Planner
9A
9B. Conditional Use Permit 14-007 Time Extension No. 1
Los Angeles County Raceway MX, Applicant
A request for a ten-year time extension to a previously approved motocross track use located at 7010 East Avenue T.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2019-052 approving Conditional Use Permit 14-007 Time Extension No. 1 and find that the project will not result in any changes to the previously adopted Mitigated Negative Declaration. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
9B
9C. Conditional Use Permit 08-01 Major Modification No. 1
Vulcan Materials Company, Applicant
A request to expand the existing mining operation (California Mine ID # 91-19-0020) to include a 20-acre site consisting of three parcels directly south of Avenue T between 72nd Street East and 80th Street East.
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission continue this item to a date uncertain to allow sufficient time to coordinate the review of documents related to the expansion with the State. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
9C
4. Presentation
4A. General Plan Update
An overview of community engagement to date and solicit feedback on the draft vision and guiding principles for the General Plan update.
Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
10. Staff Communications
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
11. Planning Commission Communications
